newsitem.title: USA: Modern Medical buys Sylvania interest.
newsitem.headline: Modern Medical buys Sylvania interest.

text.p: Modern Medical Modalities Corp said on Wednesday its Ohio Medical Equipment Leasing Corp unit had bought a majority equity interest as a managing partner in Sylvania Diagnostics LP.
The company said it bought the interest in Sylvania, a diagnostic imaging center, from Medical Advances Inc.
The company also entered into a financing agreement to provide money to run the Sylvania center.
Sylvania had 1995 revenues of just under $1.2 million.

Under terms of the financing agreement, if Ohio Medical finds that the Sylvania facility is not profitable, the unnamed financing company will buy Ohio Medical's interest in the center at the original purchase price.
